title: Indian Doubles: Who After Satwik-Chirag?

summary: Chief national coach Gopichand highlights the challenge of building a robust doubles pipeline, stressing the need to convert grassroots talent into a structured system to bridge the gap to elite international standards.

title: India's World Championships Medal Prospects Decoded

title: BWF Content with World Championships Venue
